beats.text: Indrajit slipped away to perform a sacred ritual at the shrine of Nikumbhila. If he finished it, no one could ever defeat him.
To distract Rama, he first created a false vision of Sita in danger. Rama was heartbroken.
Vibhishana rushed to him. 'It is a trick! Sita is safe. He is buying time for his ritual.'
Vibhishana knew the secret and led Lakshmana to the ritual grounds.
Lakshmana broke the ritual and challenged Indrajit.
They fought for three days and nights. Arrows covered the sky like a storm.
At last Lakshmana took an arrow and swore: 'If Rama is truly devoted to dharma, let this arrow end this battle.'
After a terrible fight, Lakshmana's arrow found its mark. Ravana's greatest warrior was no more.
